package_artifacts.integration: src/pd/batch.rs: complete Controller constructor, token/first-request admission, pending drains and extra waiting, timer-only fetch, indexed finish/default override, borrowed request view/short-circuit iteration, request count, AIAD target and observation-before-adjustment, extra batching time. Rust RAII extends source deferred cleanup to dropped futures.

src/pd/batch_tests.rs ports every assertion of TestAdjustBestBatchSize, TestFinishCollectedRequests and TestFetchPendingRequests. Original shared-pointer completion uses Arc. TestMain goleak responsibility is covered by no controller-owned worker, scoped futures and explicit request/token/resource cleanup; original Go race/goleak tests run unchanged.

dependency_decisions.native: Existing Cancellation, tokio mpsc receiver, semaphore OwnedSemaphorePermit, monotonic Sleep/Instant. A successful pending fetch transfers the token; failure or future drop returns it before default finish. Timer-only error retains caller ownership. Duration::ZERO represents nonpositive optional wait. None represents zero extra-start time.

Source request/token channels remain open throughout their owner lifetime. Rust closure is terminal and finishes collected work instead of synthesizing zero-value T. Error identity on cancellation remains Error::ContextCanceled. Requests are non-Clone; moving them into finish callbacks drops values and retains Vec capacity rather than retaining Go backing-array references.

Zero max preserves the empty early return. Initial best size stays eight even below max; push checks the source max+1 storage bound rather than silently inventing a clamp. Production TSO/router maxima exceed eight. Negative maxima are not representable by Rust usize.

Existing prometheus Rust dependency; optional Histogram observation occurs before AIAD adjustment. TSO uses source default pd_client_request_handle_tso_best_batch_size name/help and 13 exponential buckets from 1 by 2. Other metric/option variants remain parent-package work.

Short mutex pool keeps completed empty controllers for reuse and does not retain senders. One default RPC token bounds buffers to the in-flight batch and next collector. Source pool GC and dynamic-concurrency policy are not separate package claims.
Rust assertions, paused-time lifecycle tests and resource-drop checks. Unchanged original Go tests run with race detection and goleak; no failpoints occur in this package or used support path.
